assertions.claim: Chapter splits 'is marriage worth it' into separately countable accounts: money, time, health, legal risk, relationship quality
assertions.cn_span: 本节把「结婚划不划算」拆成几笔可以分开算的账：钱、时间、健康、法律风险和关系质量

assertions.claim: Each account gives only numbers findable in official statistics or meta-analyses; no moral judgment, no conclusion made for the reader
assertions.cn_span: 每笔账只给官方统计或荟萃分析里能找到的数字，不做道德判断，也不替读者下结论

assertions.claim: Health figures in death-risk terms, time figures in minutes per day, legal ones in statute wording; the three measures are not interconverted
assertions.cn_span: 健康类数字按死亡风险口径，时间类数字按每日分钟口径，法律类按条文口径，三者不互相换算

assertions.claim: Method, fill-in checklist and common pitfalls are in the linked docs file
assertions.cn_span: 拆账方法、填空清单和常见误区见
